# Isolde Pembroke & Odette Pullen

- [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md) — Friend of — [Odette Pullen](../character/odette-pullen.md) — companions · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde walk to [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) school together while discussing their schoolmates and their beautiful surroundings. During afternoon classes, [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) teases [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) by calling her 'Carrots' and pulling her hair, prompting an enraged [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to smash her slate over his head.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

> In class, [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) teases [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) about her red hair, prompting her to smash her slate over his head in anger. Mr. [Pidgeon](../character/pidgeon.md) punishes [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) by forcing her to stand at the front of the room and later making her sit beside Hugh, leading [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to declare that she will never return to school. Upon returning home, [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) seeks advice from [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), who recommends letting [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) rest at home until her temper subsides.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

> While [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and Mrs. Sowerby attend a political rally in town, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) spend a quiet evening at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters). [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md) rushes in to ask for help when her baby sister, [Posy Fay](../character/posy-fay.md), contracts croup while their parents are away. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) uses her experience to treat [Posy Fay](../character/posy-fay.md) through the night until a doctor arrives, saving the child's life before returning home to rest.
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns home on the last day of school, emotional over Mr. Pidgeon's departure and discussing the upcoming arrival of the new clergyman, Mr. [Wace](../character/wace.md), and his wife. She later discusses the church's new leadership, her Sunday school experiences, and her excitement about baking a cake for the new minister's visit, which she practices for while spending time with Isolde by the Nymph's Well.
>

> At a party hosted by [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) accepts a dare from [Flossie Tulk](../character/flossie-tulk.md) to walk across the kitchen roof's ridgepole. She slips and falls, breaking her ankle in the process. Mr. [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md) carries her home to [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) spends the next seven weeks recovering in bed while friends, neighbors, and local figures visit her.
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns to school under the guidance of her new teacher, Miss [Thorne](../character/thorne.md), and excitedly shares her academic achievements and upcoming school concert plans with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md). While [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) remains skeptical of the concert and physical activities, [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) offers [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) his steady support and encouragement.
>

> Following the excitement of the school concert, routine resumes at [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) while [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde discuss turning thirteen and working on school essays along the [Aspen Path](../codex/places.md#aspen-path). [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) shares a dramatic story she wrote for Miss Thorne's assignment, inspiring the creation of a private story club with Isolde and other girls. When [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) discusses the club's creative endeavors with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) dismisses the story writing as foolish and harmful to her studies.
>

> At [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) tells [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) that Miss [Thorne](../character/thorne.md) offered to include her in a special class to prepare for the Regent's entrance exam. Excited by the chance to train as a teacher, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) accepts and joins the class alongside her peers, though she mourns that Isolde will not be participating with her.
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) enjoys a relaxing, healthy summer after a doctor advises outdoor play to preserve her health. Returning to her studies in autumn, she works hard under Miss Thorne's guidance to prepare for the upcoming Entrance examination despite her growing anxieties. As she physically matures and reflects on her changes, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) experiences a bittersweet realization of [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) growing up.
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) completes her entrance examinations in town, staying with [Aunt Lavinia](../character/aunt-lavinia.md), and returns to [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) to anxiously await the results. After weeks of tense waiting, Isolde brings the newspaper showing that [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) tied for first place on the island. Overjoyed, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) shares the glorious news with [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md), [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), and Mrs. Sowerby.
>

> In her room at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) gets dressed for a charity concert with help and advice from Isolde and [Aunt Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md). Afterward, [Barney](../character/barney-pullen.md) and [Odette Pullen](../character/odette-pullen.md) arrive to take [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde to the [Pale Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#pale-sands-hotel). Upon arriving, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) is overwhelmed by the elegant crowd and suffers severe stage fright when called to perform.
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) overcomes a wave of severe stage fright when she spots [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) smiling in the back of the hall, which spurs her determination not to let him mock her. Her initial recitation and encore earn high praise from the audience and notable attendees. Afterward, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), Isolde, and [Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md) enjoy supper and depart together, reflecting cheerfully on the evening as [Barney](../character/barney-pullen.md) waits outside.
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and her classmates adjust to life at Regent's [Academy](../codex/places.md#regent-s-academy) as exams approach, balancing academic rivalry and friendships. Meanwhile, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) continues visiting [Miss Pembroke](../character/miss-pembroke.md) at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood) and maintains a positive perspective on her studies and upcoming examinations.

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) learns that she has won the [Avery](../codex/places.md#avery) scholarship while [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) wins the Medal. After graduation, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns home to [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) and reunites with Isolde, before learning from [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) about Obed's failing health and concerns regarding their savings bank.
